name: @pipeworx/mcp-meteors

tools.name: get_fireballs
tools.description: Track recent meteor impacts and atmospheric explosions detected by US government sensors. Returns impact energy, radiated energy, velocity, altitude, and geographic location.

limit.description: Maximum number of fireball events to return (default 10, max 100).

tools.name: get_close_approaches
tools.description: Find near-Earth asteroids making close approaches within 0.05 AU. Returns object name, approach date, miss distance, velocity, and diameter to identify potentially hazardous objects.

limit.description: Maximum number of close approach records to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: get_neo_feed
tools.description: Get near-Earth objects passing Earth during a date range (e.g., "2024-01-01" to "2024-12-31"). Returns asteroid names, sizes, velocities, miss distances, and hazard status.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Maximum 7-day range from start_date (e.g. "2025-01-07").

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-meteors forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the meteors pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
